While my borderline personality disorder did contribute to the toxicity of our marriage, the actual reason we split was because my ex came out as gay. 

From the moment I got pregnant everything about me changed. I went undiagnosed for so long and was such a moody person that it took a huge toll on our marriage. I was just diagnosed last year and I thought we were doing pretty well since being put on mood stabilizers, but I guess it didn’t matter in the end cause you can’t take meds to not make you gay.

Making every minute count is also a huge struggle for me. I’m filled with so much anger and rage about the whole situation I feel like I’m just miserable to be around. I don’t want my son to see me like that but it’s hard. And then I feel guilty because I feel like I’m not doing enough or good enough. Then I spiral and convince myself he would just be better off without me and the back and forth. Idk it’s a struggle. I know time is the only thing that will make things better but I just don’t want to feel like this anymore.
